# Assessment Facts Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during assessment.

- [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level application architecture and internal component relationship diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md): Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md): Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md): Database configuration, ER model, repositories, and data ownership boundaries.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, properties, profiles, and secrets inventory.
- [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md): Domain mapping, primary workflows, and business sequence diagram.
